name: moka
description: Moka HR 工作流。读取招聘流程、阶段和审批表单；用户明确调用时写入 offer、阶段推进、入职和人事异动。未配置 API Key 时不发请求。

api_key.title: MOKA_API_KEY
api_key.description: Required Moka API key. Used only as HTTP Basic username with an empty password. No default. Unset keeps every live call in setup_required. Do not paste the key into chat.

api_host.title: MOKA_API_HOST
api_host.description: Optional https origin. Documented values are api.mokahr.com, api-staging-3.mokahr.com, and hire-r1-api.mokahr.com. Unset uses https://api.mokahr.com, the documented China production host. Other hosts are refused.

ent_code.title: MOKA_ENT_CODE
ent_code.description: Required for People approval-form reads and People writes. Tenant id from the CSM. No default.

api_code.title: MOKA_API_CODE
api_code.description: Required only for People approval-form reads. Interface code from Moka People 设置 - 对外接口设置, data source 审批表单详情查询. No default.

private_key.title: MOKA_PRIVATE_KEY
private_key.description: Required for People approval-form reads and People writes. PKCS#8 private key, PEM or base64. Used only to sign the request. No default. Do not paste the key into chat. Alternatively set MOKA_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE to an absolute path and leave this empty.

user_name.title: MOKA_USER_NAME
user_name.description: Required only for people-add-job-change. User email included in the documented query and signature. No default.

job_change_api_code.title: MOKA_JOB_CHANGE_API_CODE
job_change_api_code.description: Required only for people-add-job-change. Interface code from 设置 - 对外接口设置, data source 新增异动记录接口. Do not reuse the approval-form apiCode.

onboarding_api_code.title: MOKA_ONBOARDING_API_CODE
onboarding_api_code.description: Required only for people-create-onboarding. Interface code from 设置 - 对外接口设置, data source 批量新增待入职员工. Do not reuse another data source code.
